# PageStore, database and Chat lessons

The hosted Python gallery can now mount the existing PageStore/WebSocket,
Kajenn/Asqueel customer and base Chat catalogues alongside ordinary examples.
The deployment uses the shared invented PostgreSQL data and limits customer
writes to name and email; performance sessions remain read-only. Customer saving
passes the primary key separately so it does not require UPDATE on the ID.

Teaching notes distinguish the hosted PostgreSQL model from the local SQLite
fixture and explain shared demo writes. Deployment checks cover database
privileges, PageStore frames/windows, customer save/reload with restoration, and
Chat echo/reset. Remote Edit remains disabled; core and server APIs are unchanged.
